title: Home cooking on Lê Hồng Phong, then the river after dark
meet: Front gate of Da Nang Cathedral (the pink church), 156 Trần Phú
bring: Nothing. On weekdays the dragon doesn't breathe fire, so the riverside is quiet.

stops.what: Meet at the cathedral gate
stops.leg: Walk 500 m

stops.what: Bếp Hên, 47 Lê Hồng Phong. Central Vietnamese home cooking, dishes shared at one table booked for the group
stops.leg: Walk 1.3 km: down to the Dragon Bridge head, then north along the Bạch Đằng riverside

title: Garden dinner and gelato on Trần Phú
meet: Entrance of Xóm Mới Garden, 222 Trần Phú

stops.what: Xóm Mới Garden, 222 Trần Phú. Vietnamese dishes to share in a garden courtyard
stops.leg: Walk 550 m

stops.what: Boulevard Gelato, Pastry & Coffee, 77 Trần Quốc Toản. Gelato to finish

title: Bánh xèo at the end of the alley, then durian chè
meet: The mouth of alley K280 on Hoàng Diệu, under the alley sign

stops.what: Meet at the alley and walk in together
Bánh xèo Bà Dưỡng, K280/23 Hoàng Diệu. Crisp bánh xèo and nem lụi, rolled at the table and dipped in peanut-and-liver sauce. Early, because it can sell out by 20:00
stops.leg: Walk 350 m up Hoàng Diệu

stops.what: Chè Liên, 189 Hoàng Diệu. Chè sầu riêng (durian sweet soup)

title: The fish market on the sand at Mân Thái, then mì Quảng
meet: The beach side of Hoàng Sa road at Mân Thái fish market (Chợ Cá Mân Thái)
bring: Sandals you can get wet. Runs only when the boats go out.

stops.what: Watch the basket boats bring the night's catch ashore and the market form on the sand
stops.leg: Walk 1.2 km inland through the Mân Thái lanes

stops.what: Mì Quảng Nia, 57 Phùng Tá Chu. A morning-only noodle shop

title: Mỹ Khê beachfront at first light, coffee down an alley
meet: The dove square in East Sea Park (Công viên Biển Đông), on Võ Nguyên Giáp
bring: A hat. By 08:00 the sun is strong.

stops.what: Meet among the doves
stops.leg: Walk 1.4 km south along the beachfront while the beach is full of swimmers, runners and tai chi groups, then 300 m inland

stops.what: Cửa Ngõ Café, alley 65 Tô Hiến Thành. Coffee in a courtyard

meet: Main gate of Linh Ứng Pagoda (Lady Buddha), Hoàng Sa road, Sơn Trà
cost: About 60,000–100,000₫ each, plus a shared ride
bring: Covered shoulders and knees for the pagoda

stops.what: Walk the pagoda grounds to the 67 m statue and the view back over the bay
stops.leg: Ride 7 km, about 15 minutes

stops.what: Banh mi & Coffee Nhà Việt, 04 Hà Chương. Bánh mì and coffee

title: Night market, dinner by the river, a walk on the promenade

stops.what: Hoi An Night Market. Lantern stalls and street snacks
stops.leg: Walk 500 m back across the An Hội bridge

stops.what: Hoi An Heart Restaurant, 68 Bạch Đằng. Vietnamese and vegetarian dishes
stops.leg: Walk 600 m along the Old Town promenade

title: The Old Town lanes while the motorbikes are out, then mì Quảng
meet: The Kazik statue, in the small park at 138 Trần Phú
bring: Nothing. Doesn't run on the lantern night (14th of the lunar month) or when the riverfront is flooded.

stops.leg: Walk a 1.3 km loop through the car-free lanes: west on Trần Phú to the Japanese Bridge, back along Nguyễn Thái Học, down to the Bạch Đằng riverfront and east to the market

stops.what: Leave the market
stops.leg: Walk 400 m

stops.what: Mì Quảng Ông Hai, 6A Trương Minh Lượng. Mì Quảng and cao lầu

meet: The mouth of alley 45 on Trần Hưng Đạo

stops.what: Xí mà stall, 45/17 Trần Hưng Đạo. A small bowl of warm black sesame sweet soup, sold from mid-afternoon until it runs out
stops.leg: Walk 1 km south through the Old Town and across the Cẩm Nam bridge

cost: About 60,000₫ for dinner, plus the pottery session (about 150,000–250,000₫, to confirm)

stops.what: Gốm An Nhiên, 84 Nguyễn Chí Thanh. A pottery session: everyone shapes a cup on the wheel. The studio fires it and you collect it later

title: The fish market at dawn, a sunrise paddle, then mì Quảng
meet: In front of Mân Thái Beach – Chợ Cá Gỗ café, on Hoàng Sa road
cost: About 100,000₫ each for the board (200,000₫ per board for two at weekends), plus 40,000–60,000₫ for breakfast
bring: Swimwear, a towel, a dry bag for your phone. You must be able to swim. Life jackets are provided.

stops.what: Walk down to the sand: basket boats land the night's catch and the market forms around them
Stand-up paddle boards from the rental on the beach, two to a board. Paddle out past the moored boats and watch the sun come up over Sơn Trà
stops.leg: Walk 1 km inland through the Mân Thái lanes. On the way if you like: Mân Thái market

stops.what: Mì Quảng Nia, 57 Phùng Tá Chu. A morning-only noodle shop
stops.leg: Optional: 200 m to Cà Phê Lối Nhỏ, 122 Trần Duy Chiến, for coffee
